source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "mobile money" AND (urban OR city OR traders OR vendors OR merchants)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"mobile money" AND (urban OR city OR traders OR vendors OR merchants),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("mobile money" AND ("city" OR "merchants" OR "traders" OR "urban" OR "vendors"))
